'''Ted Cohen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2000 Marlton tournament (20 August)]] on 20 August 2000 with [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|There Is Good In Him]], according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1155">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-22-marlton-nj-20-aug-00d1155/ marlton-nj-20-aug-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 22 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-22-marlton-nj-20-aug-00d1155/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
